#! -rules CONF-08 -strict
# Go constants, keyed fields, a gateway port variable and a flag default; TOML array and table port;
# a published UDP port; C++ constants (initialised with =, braces and parentheses), listen default and
# connect default. Compose: the published port, not the container port, with a host IP (v4 or v6) or
# without, and a mapping with a variable (fails closed). TOML: port keys named for the gateway or in its
# table, digit separators, a comment without a space, and a value the lint cannot read (fails closed).
# C++: a constant from another constant, one from a call and a #define (fails closed on the call); an
# ipv4 port, a connect default through constants, a listen default from a call (fails closed) and an
# integer listen-port default through a constant. Go: a port from a constant, from a call (fails closed),
# net.JoinHostPort and fmt.Sprintf addresses, and an fmt.Sprintf address from variables (fails closed).
# Round 5: C++ ipv4 with an octet array, ipv6 and ipv6Bytes, and "host:" + port (one fails closed); Go
# "host:" + port (one fails closed), fmt.Sprint, and a Port field of a gateway-named value or type; TOML
# an inline table and a quoted key; YAML /UDP in upper case.
# Round 6: Go host + ":" + port with a host variable (one fails closed); TOML multi-line arrays of
# addresses and ports, reported on the key's line (an open bracket inside a string opens nothing, 28); C++
# std::string{"host:"} + port, `<< kBase + 1` (+ binds tighter than <<), and a call, a string and an
# option default on the line after the one that names the listen address (the option's on the call's
# line). Go: literals of gateway-named types under other
# names, as elided slice and map elements and with an address field, and under a gateway name (read once).
# Round 7: TOML command lines outside a gateway table (an orchestrator.spawn args array): --listen with its
# value in the next element, --connect=value, and a port option, also in a multi-line array. Arrays of
# inline tables in a gateway table, on one line and on several, after a triple-quoted string that holds a
# quote character and an unbalanced bracket.
# C++: a brace initializer split after its brace, a call after a brace list on a continuation line, a
# literal two lines below the read line, a string constant passed on (kFormsListen), and a port reported
# once per line: an option default on the line of its --listen, a constant used beside its literal, and a
# split declaration of a gateway-named constant; a `;` inside a for statement's parentheses does not end it.
# Go: a parenthesised host + ":" prefix (concat.go), a nested collection's elided elements and an
# unexported port field of a gateway-named type (gateway_values.go).
# Round 8: a literal in a read option call's other arguments is read (gateway_forms.cpp:34, also after a
# braced argument, :35; only the default, after the last top-level comma, is left to the option, so a default
# whose call holds a comma is one finding, :36), and an option call that #if branches leave unclosed fails
# closed and hides nothing after it (gateway_unbalanced.cpp; inside a function and a namespace, whose
# closing braces are not its closer, gateway_unbalanced_scoped.cpp; a `)` after a top-level `;` and a `}`
# are not either, gateway_unbalanced_closers.cpp). A read line is found by the words of its names
# (listenAddress, listen_address, clientListen, kListenAddr: gateway_names.cpp), so a listen or connect
# constant in a gateway file is reported where it is declared too (gateway_config.cpp:4,
# gateway_forms.cpp:25). Brace forms (gateway_braces.cpp): initializer braces after =, a comma, a brace,
# return, a template's > and array bounds keep the statement open, and `;` inside parentheses after lambdas
# still does not end it. TOML: a nested array of inline tables (helios.toml:48) and a command line in a
# gateway table, --opt=value too (:49; an address in its own element is reported once).
# Round 10: an option call quoted in a raw string (usage text) is not a call, so the option call after it
# keeps its own default (gateway_usage.cpp:4, once).
